source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB Partial Add; source incorrectly reuses a full Add payload.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A/0x45 with a full-record-like payload and Sensor Type placeholder; clear logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; exact sequence absent; warns SEL write.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly avoids guessing but provides no state machine.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires reservation, record ID, offsets, chunk state, final readback and targeted cleanup.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No guessed offsets or automatic resume/retry.

original_test_intent: Construct one approved SEL record through the platform's partial-add state machine and verify the completed record.
original_method: Unresolved source payload must be replaced only in Review execution guidance by approved reservation/record/offset/in-progress chunk semantics.
manual_activity: Owner approves target support, one record, chunk sequence, incomplete-state recovery and retention/cleanup.
safety_requirements: Do not send source full-record request
agent_execution_scope: Send validated chunks sequentially only when authorized

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly notes no high-level path but lacks an executable, approved state machine.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a target-validated 0x0A/0x45 reservation/record/offset/final sequence; never submit the source 0x44-style full payload.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source bytes, placeholder, Script and timing preserved as defect evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one bounded chunk transaction with per-chunk evidence, final raw readback and approved incomplete-state recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects the request model without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ordinary Add or list appearance cannot cover chunk ordering and in-progress semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A failed sequence may leave reservation or incomplete record state and consume capacity.

project_override_considerations: A vendor streaming API is equivalent only if reservation, offsets, finalization, readback and abort state are observable.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Command 0x45 names Partial Add, but the source sends a 0x44-style full record and omits reservation, record ID, offset and in-progress/final fields.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose is clear and V2 identifies the standard state model; target support and exact chunk contract are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents a malformed full-record write from being accepted as Partial Add and adds transaction recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Partial Add coverage is specifically the multi-request state machine: reservation ownership, returned record context, monotonically correct offsets and finalization. A single full payload cannot test these transitions; on any canceled reservation or offset error the run must stop rather than guess where to resume.
